Chapter 6736: I’M Done Playing, I Am Li Baye

Chapter 6736: I’m Done Playing, I Am Li Baye

All living beings could look up and see his primordial tree. It differed from the other trees since it was real, not just images.

At the base was a unique being - where he stood became the center of the universe.

“Who?!” Immortals became startled; some harbored hostility.

After all, his appearance implied a desire to rule the worlds. How could this not antagonize others?

“I’m done playing. Starting today, I, Li Baye, one night more than Qiye, will be the eternal lord of the primordial dao.” He declared slowly. Dao, laws, and primordial powers emerged to show their support.

Earlier, dao sources shattered from Dao’s End Halo. This made cultivation impossible.

However, as the three thousand worlds hovered around him and his tree, primordial laws returned.

Immortals, even the strongest ones, were surprised after listening to his declaration.

Li Baye? One more night than Li Qiye. They had never heard of this name before, despite having lived for epochs.

“Let the dao pour into the three thousand worlds, may the laws follow heaven, earth, and men.” He merely appeared and his primordial power filled the world.

When he stepped into another world, a tree was born and formed a dao source. It began fueling everything with primordial energy.

“Who permits you?!” A vast immortal force retaliated and became one with this world, intending to stop the influx of new energy.

“I do not agree!” Another world lord shouted, sealing his world to prevent primordial energy from entering.

“Laws shall not follow.” A deep voice in another world wanted to devour the primordial energy.

“Leave!” More and more lords appeared to resist the new order.

Although these lords had lost their dao sources to Dao’s End Halo, they could still rebuild in the future. However, this Li Baye appeared out of nowhere and wanted to seize their spot.

The immortals couldn’t accept this, hence their interference. They formed an unspoken alliance with a common goal of stopping him.

“My dao does not need your permission. If you wish to stop me, fight.” Li Baye said with a smile, challenging all immortals.

They were enraged by his provocation and displayed their overwhelming might. They sealed worlds with radiant barriers, determined to stop his dao proliferation.

The nine major worlds shook violently. Within Heavenly Desolace, a statue floated into the air.

At the same time, a soul from Eight Desolaces traveled through the dimension and entered the statue, causing it to crumble.

A woman emerged from the boundless radiance, causing all immortals to feel as if they had been struck in the chest.

She could suppress the high heaven as she controlled the grand momentum of Heavenly Desolace. This was the greatest barrier for both offense and defense in Heaven Realm.

“Hong Tian!” Others recognized the empress.

“Min Ren’s dead, but not her?” An immortal became startled.

“She stands, so does Heavenly Desolace.” Other immortals could only retreat.

“Who dares refuse the dao infusion?” She represented Guardian Alliance.

“We accept the dao infusion.” Older immortals from Guardian Alliance voiced their support.

“Buzz.” Strands of golden light blossomed in a major world.

Within an ocean of golden laws was someone holding a heavenly scale. It judged mortals and immortals equally.

“Let the dao pour into the three thousand worlds, may the laws follow heaven, earth, and men. Judgment.” The man inside placed a primordial law onto the scale.

It remained balanced, hence his conclusion: “Permitted.”
